title: FaultEvent
description: One fault of a machine or a service that is raised or cleared, the way a service publishes it on the broker under hydra/faults/. The server reads these messages, keeps the active faults and the history and offers them to the feeds (MTConnect, OPC UA). A fault is identified by source, robot_id and code: a cleared event closes the raised one with the same three. The field that names the contract is called schema (the value carries its own version) and not schema_version, because the messages predate the other contracts. The texts are short on purpose, a fault is a line and not a log; a reader cuts anything longer. The schema is closed: a service that wants to say more says it in another message.

source.description: The service or node that raises the fault.

code.description: The fault, as a stable code the source chooses.

state.description: raised opens the fault, cleared closes it.

severity.description: How serious the fault is. A reader that does not know the value takes error.

robot_id.description: The robot the fault belongs to; absent or null when it belongs to the source as a whole.

text.description: One line for the person who reads the fault.
